content: रामा [रमतेऽनया रम् करणे घञ्] .²1 A beautiful woman, a charming young woman; अथ रामा विकसन्मुखी बभूव <ls>Bv. 2. 16</ls>, <ls n="Bv.">3. 6</ls>. .²2 A beloved, wife, mistress; रामो रामावबोधितः <ls>R. 12. 23</ls>; पप्रच्छ रामां रमणोऽभिलाषम् <ls n="R.">14. 27</ls>. .²3 A woman in general; रामा हरन्ति हृदयं प्रसभं नराणाम् <ls>Ṛs. 6. 25</ls>. .²4 A woman of origin. .²5 Vermilion. .²6 Aśa Foetida. .²7 A kind of pigment (गोरोचना). .²8 Ruddle. .²9 A river. .²10 An accomplished woman (versed in fine arts). .²11 A kind of metre. .²12 (In music) A kind of measure.
